reading.title: Checking a practice agreement
reading.text: Nadia reads a fictional contract before a language workshop. It records an agreement with terms and conditions. She identifies a payment clause and asks how an amendment changes the text. An addendum supplies extra information. A breach means failure to meet an obligation; it is not simply an unfamiliar word. The instructor distinguishes void from binding, but does not decide whether a real document is enforceable. A separate court file contains a complaint and summons. A subpoena requests evidence under legal authority, a motion asks the court to act, and a brief presents legal arguments. Nadia labels these functions in her notes. She asks for professional clarification before using a real document, since requirements depend on the jurisdiction.

reading.title: Comparing document purposes
reading.text: In the workshop, a petition asks an authority to act. An order records its direction, an injunction requires or prohibits an action, and a warrant authorizes a specified official act. An indictment is an accusation, not a finding of guilt. Nadia then reviews a separate personal-planning file. A will concerns property after death; a trust concerns property managed for beneficiaries. A power of attorney gives someone authority to act for another person. A living will records treatment wishes when a person cannot communicate. A deed records a property interest, title concerns ownership, and a lease concerns use of property. Prenuptial means before marriage; a divorce decree and adoption papers have other purposes. The class compares functions without completing legal forms.

reading.title: Organizing a business document folder
reading.text: A designer organizes sample business documents for a training session. A patent concerns an invention, a trademark identifies goods or services, and copyright protects original creative expression. A license gives permission under stated terms. The designer asks a lawyer about the differences rather than assuming that one protection covers everything. A sample NDA concerns confidential information. A non-compete addresses restricted competition, but its enforceability depends on applicable law. A partnership agreement describes a partnership's operation. Articles of incorporation establish a corporation through the relevant filing process. Bylaws govern internal activities, while an operating agreement may govern a limited liability company. These documents have different functions; the training folder does not establish anyone's rights or obligations.
